content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial (service not separately payable), which is a factual/coding dispute, not a medical-necessity issue—the prior necessity appeal was the wrong instrument and failed. To overturn a bundling edit, the payer needs documentation showing the service was separately identifiable and distinct from the bundled procedure, so attaching supporting records is the appropriate next progression. Retro-auth is not offered and auth isn't required here, resubmission as-is or plain correction won't address the bundling logic, and the balance isn't yet uncollectible.","action":"submit_with_records"}
